name: Holiday Warm Baked Brie in Puff Pastry with Honey & Water Crackers (No Nuts/Cranberries)
whyItWorks: Ripened Brie is naturally very low in lactose (<0.5g per serving) because the mold cultures break down the milk sugars; drizzled with pure honey inside flaky puff pastry with plain water crackers, it is a safe holiday party starter.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Top the wheel of Brie with pure honey or seedless apricot preserves before wrapping in puff pastry—leave off chopped pecans/walnuts and whole cranberries.
watchOuts: Skip chopped pecans, walnuts, and whole cranberry-orange toppings; eat a modest portion as puff pastry is high in butterfat
